answer.reason: Two verses tell of events that befell the lowland country: Joshua's conquest of it and the Philistine invasion of its cities.

clauses.english: was struck by Joshua along with the hills and the south, and none was left remaining
clauses.quote: smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale

clauses.english: had its cities invaded and some of them taken by the Philistines
clauses.quote: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country

doubts: JOS 10:40 says "vale" and 2CH 28:18 says "low country"; I took both as this region.
Left out the verses that only list regions or mention sycomore trees, herds, or fields in the vale, plain or low plains, since they say nothing that happened to the place.
DEU 1:7, JOS 9:1, JOS 11:2, JOS 11:16, JOS 12:8, JOS 15:33, JDG 1:9, JER 32:44, JER 33:13, OBA 1:19 and ZEC 7:7 only list the lowland among other regions or towns, so I did not use them.
